name: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E)

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 10.51 percent a year from FY2021 (1.8009e+08) to FY2025 (2.68615e+08), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 2.03282e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 2.03282e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on Q1 2026 (three months ended 31 March 2026), the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are Q1 2026 (three months ended 31 March 2026), an interim and not annualised.
